dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: You think so too...? *Sigh* But for some reason the toys just aren't flying off the shelves. I've spent so much time on them, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Tikhomirov
dialogues.text: "A set of nesting dolls that can be assembled, transform, and even fly!" All the things kids like, all in one toy!
